criteria.criterion: A new best-effort producer `transition_close.record_completion_verdict(result, ticket_id, repo_root, *, sign=True)` emits the `COMPLETION_VERDICT` sidecar (PASS/FAIL) and, on an attested, certifiable PASS pinned to a `verified_at_sha`, signs the reusable `completion-verifier` op-cert via the shared producer `sign_completion_verdict`. It never signs a `local`/uncertifiable/non-PASS verdict and never raises.

`rebar verify-completion` records by default with a `--no-sign` opt-out (symmetric with `review-plan`'s `--no-sign`); text output reports what was recorded. The committed CLI help artifact is regenerated.
The MCP `verify_completion` tool records unless the server is read-only; the outcome rides on the result's `record` field.

Tests prove a standalone attested PASS is signed and REUSED by a later same-ref close (verifier provider never called), and that `--no-sign` / `local` source / `certifiable=False` / FAIL each record correctly without signing.
